subject.title: [Bug]: Detached native Codex subagents lose hook relay when parent turn releases

question: Should detached native Codex children receive child-owned relay registrations, or should the parent/session relay be retained until all detached native children settle?
rationale: Both paths can preserve the reported behavior, but the durable ownership model determines policy isolation, cleanup, and whether relay absence can ever change enforcement semantics.

options.title: Use child-owned relays
options.body: Create and clean up a relay per detached native child so the child’s policy path is independent of parent-turn finalization.

options.title: Retain the parent/session relay
options.body: Reference-count active detached children and defer unregistering the existing relay until the final child settles.

recommendation.title: Use child-owned relays
recommendation.body: Create and clean up a relay per detached native child so the child’s policy path is independent of parent-turn finalization.
